label: WITHHOLD_2: at some accessible world the giver exists and does not give x being
definition: WithholdsAtAccessible F w g x: some world accessible from w has g existing and g not giving x being. No choice, control, agency or setup is part of this sense. Example: an accessible world where the source exists and that recipient is absent or given being by something else. Non-example: g gives x being at every accessible world where g exists (FixedTowardAt's second clause).
note: Analyst sense (#2090, #2103). actualRootsWithholdEachGrounded_iff shows premise (a) fbd0a6d3 is this sense for each actual root and grounded actual concretum (Iff.rfl). It is per-effect: different recipients may use different worlds. Distinct from WITHHOLD_1 (dba7c7df) and from total refraining (disambiguation 6ce98992), which concerns giving nothing at one world. A source stating that the first cause could have not given this effect being would source it.
